Bug_Title: UR: Uninitialized read of field in constructor (UR_UNINIT_READ)
Bug_Details:
This constructor reads a field which has not yet been assigned a value. 
This is often caused when the programmer mistakenly uses the field instead
of one of the constructor's parameters.
Bug_Explanation: The constructor of UninitializedReadExample reads the field 'someField' through the readField method before it has been assigned a value via the constructor's parameter. The programmer mistakenly uses the field when the intention was to use the constructor's parameter.
Trigger_Explanation: The test cases call the showBug method, which in turn creates an instance of UninitializedReadExample. The constructor reads the uninitialized field 'someField' before it is set, leading to the incorrect initialization. The assertions in the test cases fail as the expected value does not match the improperly initialized 'someField'.
